question.text: Under SEBI (ICDR) Reg 292L read with LODR, every SE listed on the SSE is required to publish annually a document certified by a SEBI-registered SIA, known as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Reg 292L read with LODR Reg 91E mandates every listed SE to publish an Annual Impact Report (AIR) within 90 days of end of FY, certified by an ICAI-empanelled SIA, containing outputs/outcomes/impact against pre-listing baseline and the URN-level traceability. The Trap: BRSR is applicable to top 1,000 listed equity companies — NOT SE-specific. Social Audit Report (SAR) is an older term used under CAG/Govt schemes, not SEBI's formal label. SID is a fabricated acronym. Cross-Exam Context: III-A / III-C (Compliance) covers BRSR for listed equities; XXIII tests the AIR which is SE-specific. Do not confuse the two. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Your audit plan for AIR should mirror the Form AIR published on BSE-SSE circular (31 July 2024). Each KPI row must tie back to a URN-tagged source: hospital OPD register page-number, village record book, beneficiary consent form. Missing URN = qualified assurance.
